text:
Alin: quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to clarify region availability for EU/UK plus a short data residency note. Need a fast review before merge.
Maria: please drop the PR link here and call out any strings that need localization.
Alin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4129
Alin: diff is tiny, mainly a table row and an expanded footnote about residency. also changed the Python SDK example to pass `region='eu-west-1'` instead of `region=None`.
Alin: code snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=KEY, region='eu-west-1')
resp = client.generate('Translate to FR: Hello')
```
Sam: small flag — for Dedicated/Private deployments we should not use the hosted region strings (eu-west-1). recommend wording: "Supported regions (hosted)" vs "Private deployments: contact your account team for locality".
Keith: agree with Sam. also the region map image needs updating (assets/region-map-v2.png). can someone drop the updated svg or give me permission to edit?
Maria: also add a link to legal's residency FAQ: https://redwood-inference.internal/legal/data-residency. I'll ping @legal for sign-off. For localization: mark the new strings with i18n keys docs.regions.residency_note so Crowdin picks them up.
Alin: I'll add the i18n keys and a short migration note under "Upgrading SDKs" that calls out the region param change for older clients. can you review wording @Maria @Keith?
docs-bot: CI: docs-site build succeeded for PR #4129 :white_check_mark:
Sam: wording nit: replace "data stays in" with "data is stored and processed in" — clearer for compliance teams.
Maria: :thumbsup: good call. once legal signs off we'll ship.
Keith: i'll update the asset, tweak the hosted/private language, and do a quick review this afternoon. assigning myself.
Alin: thanks all — i'll wait for Keith + legal then merge. ping me if you want the snippet adjusted to show `region='eu-central-1'` instead for DE emphasis. :eyes:
